# Intelligence Files Starter Brief

A declassified-history starter brief for readers entering the intelligence dossiers, agency maps, source-methodology pages, and public-record archive routes.

## Branded PDF Mini Book

- PDF: downloads/lead-magnet-intelligence-files-brief.pdf

## Boundary

Lead magnets are public orientation assets with a seven-day intelligence window. They do not increase evidence strength or replace trust/privacy pages.

## Promise

Get the agency archive route: how to enter declassified files, separate official record from inference, and move into the intelligence dossier reading path.

## Reader Outcome

The reader can start researching agency files without treating every declassified fragment as a complete conclusion.

- Which archive routes matter first: declassified files, oversight records, agency releases, and public dockets.
- How to separate source, inference, allegation, and conclusion.
- How the Intelligence Dossiers series is organised as a reading path.
- Why the source-methodology page is the safety rail for darker material.
